prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Denver. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Denver for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick detail: what part of Denver are you in (ZIP code or neighborhood)? That lets me give a short list of nearby, reputable orthodontists to call.  

While you reply, here’s what I’ll do and why it matters — so you get good results fast:

What I’ll look for when I pick specific offices
- Board-certified orthodontists (American Board of Orthodontics diplomates when possible) — board certification shows extra training and standards.
- Invisalign experience (ask whether they’re an Invisalign provider and how many cases they treat per year).
- Regular use of digital scanners (iTero/TRIOS) and digital treatment planning — improves fit/comfort and predictability for aligners.
- Positive, recent patient reviews (Google/Yelp) and before/after galleries.
- Clear pricing/financing options and insurance handling.
- Free or low‑cost consultation availability so you can compare.

If you want to call 3–4 offices, I’ll pick ones that meet those criteria and are closest to your ZIP. I’ll give:
- Name of practice and lead orthodontist
- Phone number and office location
- 2–3 reasons to call them (e.g., board-certified, lots of Invisalign experience, good reviews, convenient hours)
- A short script of the most important questions to ask on the call

If you prefer to start searching on your own, these tools are the fastest:
- American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist”
- Invisalign provider locator (shows local Invisalign providers and often their experience level)
- Check American Board of Orthodontics diplomate search for board certification
- Read recent Google or Yelp reviews and view before/after photos on the practice website

Tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you prefer Invisalign vs braces, and I’ll pull 3–5 specific orthodontists to call with reasons and a phone script.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
